svg.title: RTPS DATA: the DDS layer of an SPDP announcement
svg.desc: The DATA submessage of frame 3 of talker-listener-rtps.pcapng, 32 bits per row: id 0x15, flags E and D, octetsToNextHeader 248, then extraFlags, octetsToInlineQos 16, readerId 0, the SPDP writerId 0x000100c2 and writerSN 1; then the encapsulation header, PL_CDR_LE read big-endian, and options 0; then the ParameterList, little-endian: PID_USER_DATA, PID_PROTOCOL_VERSION, PID_VENDORID whose value 01 10 is read big-endian, eight more parameters and the PID_SENTINEL; the card shows what inline_qos() and discovery() make of them.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: RTPS DATA: the DDS layer of an SPDP announcement
